mechanics.name: The Rooms of Colour
mechanics.desc: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed.
mechanics.flavor: Only the fool presses the red one first.

mechanics.name: The Rooms of Colour: Rising Colours
mechanics.desc: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. The room slowly floods instead of filling with monsters.
mechanics.flavor: Only the fool presses the red one first.

mechanics.name: The Rooms of Colour: Omen
mechanics.desc: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Only the fool presses the red one first.

mechanics.name: The Rooms of Colour: Echo
mechanics.desc: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. Repeat the pattern it shows.
mechanics.flavor: Only the fool presses the red one first.

mechanics.name: The Rooms of Colour: Arrow-Slit Colours
mechanics.desc: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. Hidden slits in the walls send arrows at whoever dawdles.
mechanics.flavor: Only the fool presses the red one first.

mechanics.name: The Rooms of Colour: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Only the fool presses the red one first.

mechanics.name: The Rooms of Colour: Synchrony
mechanics.desc: The doors close and four coloured pedestals stand in the dust; the walls hint at an order, and a wrong choice does not forgive: reinforcements trickle in every half minute until the right sequence is pressed. Light every pillar within a few seconds of each other.
mechanics.flavor: Only the fool presses the red one first.

mechanics.name: The Mirror Demon's Pattern
mechanics.desc: A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face.
mechanics.flavor: It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.

mechanics.name: The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Long Pattern
mechanics.desc: A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. A longer pattern, one more note than usual.
mechanics.flavor: It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.

mechanics.name: The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Omen
mechanics.desc: A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.

mechanics.name: The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Sequenced
mechanics.desc: A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
mechanics.flavor: It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.

mechanics.name: The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Silent Pattern
mechanics.desc: A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. A silent pattern: the flashes are shown but never sounded, so it must be watched.
mechanics.flavor: It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.

mechanics.name: The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Gaze
mechanics.desc: A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. It wakes when someone looks straight at it.
mechanics.flavor: It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.

mechanics.name: The Mirror Demon's Pattern: Switch
mechanics.desc: A demon of mimicry has made the room a game: it flashes a pattern of lights and wants it played back, and each failure feeds its taste for the player's own face. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: It learns your voice by asking you to repeat it.

mechanics.name: The Pillars of the Chain Spell
mechanics.desc: Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one.
mechanics.flavor: One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.

mechanics.name: The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Four Pillars
mechanics.desc: Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. A fourth pillar: it needs a bigger squad.
mechanics.flavor: One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.

mechanics.name: The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Omen
mechanics.desc: Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.

mechanics.name: The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Sequenced
mechanics.desc: Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
mechanics.flavor: One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.

mechanics.name: The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Quick Chain
mechanics.desc: Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. A tight window: three seconds.
mechanics.flavor: One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.

mechanics.name: The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Quorum
mechanics.desc: Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.

mechanics.name: The Pillars of the Chain Spell: Split
mechanics.desc: Three pillars of mana must be lit in one breath: a lone mage lights one and watches it die, so the whole party must reach their pillar and act as one. Two delvers must hold two plates at once.
mechanics.flavor: One mage is a spark. A squad is a spell.

mechanics.name: The Scales of Balance
mechanics.desc: A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever.
mechanics.flavor: Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.

mechanics.name: The Scales of Balance: Scales of Iron
mechanics.desc: A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. The scales want iron, not gold: more of it, and less of a bargain.
mechanics.flavor: Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.

mechanics.name: The Scales of Balance: Omen
mechanics.desc: A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.

mechanics.name: The Scales of Balance: Soul-tithe
mechanics.desc: A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. Pay a few levels of experience at the altar to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.

mechanics.name: The Scales of Balance: Scales of Blood
mechanics.desc: A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. The scales are content with a few hearts instead of gold.
mechanics.flavor: Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.

mechanics.name: The Scales of Balance: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.

mechanics.name: The Scales of Balance: Anchored
mechanics.desc: A huge pair of scales hangs over the altar and wants a weight in gold on one pan before the ceiling comes down: the ceiling is patient, but not for ever. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: Weigh your offer carefully. The ceiling already has.

mechanics.name: The Gallery of Levers
mechanics.desc: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters.
mechanics.flavor: Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.

mechanics.name: The Gallery of Levers: Gallery of Pressure
mechanics.desc: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. Pressure plates and a lever: the plate is the hint, standing on it for a few seconds does the trick.
mechanics.flavor: Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.

mechanics.name: The Gallery of Levers: Omen
mechanics.desc: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.

mechanics.name: The Gallery of Levers: Sequenced
mechanics.desc: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.

mechanics.name: The Gallery of Levers: Gallery of Bells
mechanics.desc: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. The bells are loud and relentless: a quake rattles the room until the lever is found.
mechanics.flavor: Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.

mechanics.name: The Gallery of Levers: Altar
mechanics.desc: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
mechanics.flavor: Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.

mechanics.name: The Gallery of Levers: Keystone
mechanics.desc: A long gallery of dead machinery and exactly one lever that matters: pull the wrong stud and the gallery makes a sound like a bell, and the bells draw in the monsters. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Every floor has a door. Every door has a trick.

mechanics.name: The Drum Rooms
mechanics.desc: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out.
mechanics.flavor: Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.

mechanics.name: The Drum Rooms: Fast Drum
mechanics.desc: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out. A faster drum: the walls turn twice as often.
mechanics.flavor: Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.

mechanics.name: The Drum Rooms: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.

mechanics.name: The Drum Rooms: Sequenced
mechanics.desc: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.

mechanics.name: The Drum Rooms: Bone Drum
mechanics.desc: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out. A drum of bone: each beat calls a skeleton out of the wall.
mechanics.flavor: Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.

mechanics.name: The Drum Rooms: Footfall
mechanics.desc: A demon beats a drum and the rooms turn: walls swing away and swing back with every beat, and only the pattern of the beats reveals the way out. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Every drum beat is a new room, and every new room is a new cage.

mechanics.name: The Memory of the Last Death
mechanics.desc: A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out.
mechanics.flavor: I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.

mechanics.name: The Memory of the Last Death: Death's Voice
mechanics.desc: A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out. Each reset also costs: a wound the delver does not remember taking.
mechanics.flavor: I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.

mechanics.name: The Memory of the Last Death: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.

mechanics.name: The Memory of the Last Death: Sequenced
mechanics.desc: A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
mechanics.flavor: I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.

mechanics.name: The Memory of the Last Death: The Loop
mechanics.desc: A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out. Every failure is also a reset of the room: the party is returned to the door and the pattern is shown again.
mechanics.flavor: I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.

mechanics.name: The Memory of the Last Death: Wounded
mechanics.desc: A room remembers how it killed the last delver, and shows it to the next: the pattern of the trap is the pattern of the lock, and the lock is the only way out. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
mechanics.flavor: I have seen this room before. I did not survive it.

mechanics.name: The Courier of the Pot
mechanics.desc: A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup.
mechanics.flavor: Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.

mechanics.name: The Courier of the Pot: A Very Hot Pot
mechanics.desc: A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup. The pot is hot: carrying it hurts a little, constantly.
mechanics.flavor: Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.

mechanics.name: The Courier of the Pot: Omen
mechanics.desc: A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.

mechanics.name: The Courier of the Pot: Tribute
mechanics.desc: A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup. Lay an offering on its altar to quiet it.
mechanics.flavor: Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.

mechanics.name: The Courier of the Pot: A Heavy Pot
mechanics.desc: A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup. A big pot: the courier moves like wading in mud.
mechanics.flavor: Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.

mechanics.name: The Courier of the Pot: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A stew pot sits on a stone at one end of the room and a hungry statue waits at the other: carry the pot across without losing it, over a room full of things that smell the soup. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Everything in the dungeon wants a bite.

mechanics.name: The Sunlight Relay
mechanics.desc: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test.
mechanics.flavor: Science is just patience with a lens.

mechanics.name: The Sunlight Relay: Echoing Relay
mechanics.desc: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test. The dark has voices in it: a swarm of cave biters stirs while the lantern burns.
mechanics.flavor: Science is just patience with a lens.

mechanics.name: The Sunlight Relay: Threshold
mechanics.desc: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Science is just patience with a lens.

mechanics.name: The Sunlight Relay: Anchored
mechanics.desc: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: Science is just patience with a lens.

mechanics.name: The Sunlight Relay: Mirror Relay
mechanics.desc: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test. The room is lined with mirrors that throw the light back: lit crystals dazzle the eyes.
mechanics.flavor: Science is just patience with a lens.

mechanics.name: The Sunlight Relay: Nightfall
mechanics.desc: The room is dark on purpose and a single lantern is the only key: carrying real light through it, and keeping it lit, is what the old door was built to test. It thrives where the light is low and strikes the delver who lingers in the dark.
mechanics.flavor: Science is just patience with a lens.

mechanics.name: The Sphinx's Riddle
mechanics.desc: A sphinx's carving asks its riddle in silence, the answer to which is an offering laid on its paws: wrong offerings are eaten, and what the sphinx does with an angry guest is written on the wall.
mechanics.flavor: Answer well. She is not hungry for your gold.

mechanics.name: The Sphinx's Riddle: Riddle of Coin
mechanics.desc: A sphinx's carving asks its riddle in silence, the answer to which is an offering laid on its paws: wrong offerings are eaten, and what the sphinx does with an angry guest is written on the wall. The answer is a coin, as many as the guest dares.
mechanics.flavor: Answer well. She is not hungry for your gold.

mechanics.name: The Sphinx's Riddle: Omen
mechanics.desc: A sphinx's carving asks its riddle in silence, the answer to which is an offering laid on its paws: wrong offerings are eaten, and what the sphinx does with an angry guest is written on the wall. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Answer well. She is not hungry for your gold.

mechanics.name: The Sphinx's Riddle: Blood-tithe
mechanics.desc: A sphinx's carving asks its riddle in silence, the answer to which is an offering laid on its paws: wrong offerings are eaten, and what the sphinx does with an angry guest is written on the wall. Pay in hearts at the altar to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Answer well. She is not hungry for your gold.

mechanics.name: The Sphinx's Riddle: Riddle of Life
mechanics.desc: A sphinx's carving asks its riddle in silence, the answer to which is an offering laid on its paws: wrong offerings are eaten, and what the sphinx does with an angry guest is written on the wall. The answer is paid in experience.
mechanics.flavor: Answer well. She is not hungry for your gold.

mechanics.name: The Sphinx's Riddle: Altar
mechanics.desc: A sphinx's carving asks its riddle in silence, the answer to which is an offering laid on its paws: wrong offerings are eaten, and what the sphinx does with an angry guest is written on the wall. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
mechanics.flavor: Answer well. She is not hungry for your gold.

mechanics.name: The True Path
mechanics.desc: Only one path through the room is safe and the floor says nothing about it: running across opens the false stones, and the pit beneath them is not shallow.
mechanics.flavor: The corridor looks safe. That is what makes it the trap.

mechanics.name: The True Path: The Spiked Path
mechanics.desc: Only one path through the room is safe and the floor says nothing about it: running across opens the false stones, and the pit beneath them is not shallow. The false stones hide spikes: a pointed drop on top of the fall.
mechanics.flavor: The corridor looks safe. That is what makes it the trap.

mechanics.name: The True Path: Leap
mechanics.desc: Only one path through the room is safe and the floor says nothing about it: running across opens the false stones, and the pit beneath them is not shallow. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: The corridor looks safe. That is what makes it the trap.

mechanics.name: The True Path: Muffled
mechanics.desc: Only one path through the room is safe and the floor says nothing about it: running across opens the false stones, and the pit beneath them is not shallow. Neither sprint nor jump for a while and it lets go.
mechanics.flavor: The corridor looks safe. That is what makes it the trap.

mechanics.name: The True Path: The Missing Path
mechanics.desc: Only one path through the room is safe and the floor says nothing about it: running across opens the false stones, and the pit beneath them is not shallow. Whole stretches of floor vanish rather than single stones.
mechanics.flavor: The corridor looks safe. That is what makes it the trap.

mechanics.name: The True Path: Stillness
mechanics.desc: Only one path through the room is safe and the floor says nothing about it: running across opens the false stones, and the pit beneath them is not shallow. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: The corridor looks safe. That is what makes it the trap.

mechanics.name: The Tower of Two Doors
mechanics.desc: A tower of two doors: each stays shut until two delvers stand on two plates at once, and neither can see the other plate. Trust is the hard part.
mechanics.flavor: Two doors. Two keys. Two fools, ideally friends.

mechanics.name: The Tower of Two Doors: Three Doors
mechanics.desc: A tower of two doors: each stays shut until two delvers stand on two plates at once, and neither can see the other plate. Trust is the hard part. Three doors, three plates: it needs a party of three at least.
mechanics.flavor: Two doors. Two keys. Two fools, ideally friends.

mechanics.name: The Tower of Two Doors: Omen
mechanics.desc: A tower of two doors: each stays shut until two delvers stand on two plates at once, and neither can see the other plate. Trust is the hard part. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Two doors. Two keys. Two fools, ideally friends.

mechanics.name: The Tower of Two Doors: Muster
mechanics.desc: A tower of two doors: each stays shut until two delvers stand on two plates at once, and neither can see the other plate. Trust is the hard part. Every living member of the party must stand on the plate together.
mechanics.flavor: Two doors. Two keys. Two fools, ideally friends.

mechanics.name: The Tower of Two Doors: The Slow Water
mechanics.desc: A tower of two doors: each stays shut until two delvers stand on two plates at once, and neither can see the other plate. Trust is the hard part. The water rises more slowly and never drowns, but the cold gnaws.
mechanics.flavor: Two doors. Two keys. Two fools, ideally friends.

mechanics.name: The Tower of Two Doors: Quorum
mechanics.desc: A tower of two doors: each stays shut until two delvers stand on two plates at once, and neither can see the other plate. Trust is the hard part. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: Two doors. Two keys. Two fools, ideally friends.

mechanics.name: The Majority Door
mechanics.desc: The way out is a door that opens only when everybody in the party stands together on its plate: no one can be left behind, and the longer they argue, the shorter the air.
mechanics.flavor: Majority rules. Nobody asked the minority.

mechanics.name: The Majority Door: The Tight Door
mechanics.desc: The way out is a door that opens only when everybody in the party stands together on its plate: no one can be left behind, and the longer they argue, the shorter the air. The plate is small: everyone must pack onto it.
mechanics.flavor: Majority rules. Nobody asked the minority.

mechanics.name: The Majority Door: Omen
mechanics.desc: The way out is a door that opens only when everybody in the party stands together on its plate: no one can be left behind, and the longer they argue, the shorter the air. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Majority rules. Nobody asked the minority.

mechanics.name: The Majority Door: Split
mechanics.desc: The way out is a door that opens only when everybody in the party stands together on its plate: no one can be left behind, and the longer they argue, the shorter the air. Two delvers must hold two plates at once.
mechanics.flavor: Majority rules. Nobody asked the minority.

mechanics.name: The Majority Door: The Breathless Door
mechanics.desc: The way out is a door that opens only when everybody in the party stands together on its plate: no one can be left behind, and the longer they argue, the shorter the air. The air thins while the party argues.
mechanics.flavor: Majority rules. Nobody asked the minority.

mechanics.name: The Majority Door: Quorum
mechanics.desc: The way out is a door that opens only when everybody in the party stands together on its plate: no one can be left behind, and the longer they argue, the shorter the air. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: Majority rules. Nobody asked the minority.

mechanics.name: The Runic Lock
mechanics.desc: Five runes of different colours glow in the floor like a Caster's workshop: they must be struck in the order they were carved, and the keeper of the lock does not forgive mistakes.
mechanics.flavor: A rune is a promise made to the stone.

mechanics.name: The Runic Lock: The Short Lock
mechanics.desc: Five runes of different colours glow in the floor like a Caster's workshop: they must be struck in the order they were carved, and the keeper of the lock does not forgive mistakes. Four runes only, and a kinder keeper.
mechanics.flavor: A rune is a promise made to the stone.

mechanics.name: The Runic Lock: Omen
mechanics.desc: Five runes of different colours glow in the floor like a Caster's workshop: they must be struck in the order they were carved, and the keeper of the lock does not forgive mistakes. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: A rune is a promise made to the stone.

mechanics.name: The Runic Lock: Echo
mechanics.desc: Five runes of different colours glow in the floor like a Caster's workshop: they must be struck in the order they were carved, and the keeper of the lock does not forgive mistakes. Repeat the pattern it shows.
mechanics.flavor: A rune is a promise made to the stone.

mechanics.name: The Runic Lock: The Burning Lock
mechanics.desc: Five runes of different colours glow in the floor like a Caster's workshop: they must be struck in the order they were carved, and the keeper of the lock does not forgive mistakes. Wrong runes burn the hand: an immediate flame on the touch.
mechanics.flavor: A rune is a promise made to the stone.

mechanics.name: The Runic Lock: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: Five runes of different colours glow in the floor like a Caster's workshop: they must be struck in the order they were carved, and the keeper of the lock does not forgive mistakes. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: A rune is a promise made to the stone.

mechanics.name: The Law of Equivalent Exchange
mechanics.desc: A transmutation circle in the floor wants a price in iron, and wants it exactly: what goes in must be worth what comes out, and what comes out is a way out.
mechanics.flavor: To obtain, something of equal value must be lost.

mechanics.name: The Law of Equivalent Exchange: Exchange in Gold
mechanics.desc: A transmutation circle in the floor wants a price in iron, and wants it exactly: what goes in must be worth what comes out, and what comes out is a way out. The circle wants gold instead of iron.
mechanics.flavor: To obtain, something of equal value must be lost.

mechanics.name: The Law of Equivalent Exchange: Omen
mechanics.desc: A transmutation circle in the floor wants a price in iron, and wants it exactly: what goes in must be worth what comes out, and what comes out is a way out. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: To obtain, something of equal value must be lost.

mechanics.name: The Law of Equivalent Exchange: Tribute
mechanics.desc: A transmutation circle in the floor wants a price in iron, and wants it exactly: what goes in must be worth what comes out, and what comes out is a way out. Lay an offering on its altar to quiet it.
mechanics.flavor: To obtain, something of equal value must be lost.

mechanics.name: The Law of Equivalent Exchange: Exchange in Blood
mechanics.desc: A transmutation circle in the floor wants a price in iron, and wants it exactly: what goes in must be worth what comes out, and what comes out is a way out. The circle wants blood instead of metal: a forbidden transmutation.
mechanics.flavor: To obtain, something of equal value must be lost.

mechanics.name: The Law of Equivalent Exchange: Altar
mechanics.desc: A transmutation circle in the floor wants a price in iron, and wants it exactly: what goes in must be worth what comes out, and what comes out is a way out. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
mechanics.flavor: To obtain, something of equal value must be lost.

mechanics.name: The Door of Teeth
mechanics.desc: A great stone mouth is the only door, and it opens for blood: the more it is fed, the wider it grins, and it is not shy about asking again.
mechanics.flavor: Open wide.

mechanics.name: The Door of Teeth: The Greedy Mouth
mechanics.desc: A great stone mouth is the only door, and it opens for blood: the more it is fed, the wider it grins, and it is not shy about asking again. It will take items rather than blood.
mechanics.flavor: Open wide.

mechanics.name: The Door of Teeth: Omen
mechanics.desc: A great stone mouth is the only door, and it opens for blood: the more it is fed, the wider it grins, and it is not shy about asking again. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Open wide.

mechanics.name: The Door of Teeth: Soul-tithe
mechanics.desc: A great stone mouth is the only door, and it opens for blood: the more it is fed, the wider it grins, and it is not shy about asking again. Pay a few levels of experience at the altar to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Open wide.

mechanics.name: The Door of Teeth: The Hungry Mouth
mechanics.desc: A great stone mouth is the only door, and it opens for blood: the more it is fed, the wider it grins, and it is not shy about asking again. It bites back: the door gnaws on whoever waits.
mechanics.flavor: Open wide.

mechanics.name: The Door of Teeth: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A great stone mouth is the only door, and it opens for blood: the more it is fed, the wider it grins, and it is not shy about asking again. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Open wide.

mechanics.name: The Test of Position
mechanics.desc: A test floor of the Tower: the party is told where to stand, and the answer is as much about who stands with whom as about the spot.
mechanics.flavor: A Regular must find the right place. A Wave Controller makes sure it's the wrong one.

mechanics.name: The Test of Position: Test of Pairs
mechanics.desc: A test floor of the Tower: the party is told where to stand, and the answer is as much about who stands with whom as about the spot. A test for two: two plates and two delvers who trust each other.
mechanics.flavor: A Regular must find the right place. A Wave Controller makes sure it's the wrong one.

mechanics.name: The Test of Position: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A test floor of the Tower: the party is told where to stand, and the answer is as much about who stands with whom as about the spot. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: A Regular must find the right place. A Wave Controller makes sure it's the wrong one.

mechanics.name: The Test of Position: Anchored
mechanics.desc: A test floor of the Tower: the party is told where to stand, and the answer is as much about who stands with whom as about the spot. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: A Regular must find the right place. A Wave Controller makes sure it's the wrong one.

mechanics.name: The Test of Position: Blind Test
mechanics.desc: A test floor of the Tower: the party is told where to stand, and the answer is as much about who stands with whom as about the spot. The party is blinded for the first moments and must find the plate by feel.
mechanics.flavor: A Regular must find the right place. A Wave Controller makes sure it's the wrong one.

mechanics.name: The Test of Position: Quorum
mechanics.desc: A test floor of the Tower: the party is told where to stand, and the answer is as much about who stands with whom as about the spot. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: A Regular must find the right place. A Wave Controller makes sure it's the wrong one.

mechanics.name: The Zodiac Gates
mechanics.desc: Twelve keys of the sky hang in the wall and six gates must be opened in the right order, each one a spirit who answers only the call of its own sign.
mechanics.flavor: Open, Gate of the Zodiac!

mechanics.name: The Zodiac Gates: The Three Gates
mechanics.desc: Twelve keys of the sky hang in the wall and six gates must be opened in the right order, each one a spirit who answers only the call of its own sign. Only three gates today: a smaller test.
mechanics.flavor: Open, Gate of the Zodiac!

mechanics.name: The Zodiac Gates: Omen
mechanics.desc: Twelve keys of the sky hang in the wall and six gates must be opened in the right order, each one a spirit who answers only the call of its own sign. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: Open, Gate of the Zodiac!

mechanics.name: The Zodiac Gates: Echo
mechanics.desc: Twelve keys of the sky hang in the wall and six gates must be opened in the right order, each one a spirit who answers only the call of its own sign. Repeat the pattern it shows.
mechanics.flavor: Open, Gate of the Zodiac!

mechanics.name: The Zodiac Gates: Gates in a Storm
mechanics.desc: Twelve keys of the sky hang in the wall and six gates must be opened in the right order, each one a spirit who answers only the call of its own sign. The gates open in a storm: lightning on the wrong call.
mechanics.flavor: Open, Gate of the Zodiac!

mechanics.name: The Zodiac Gates: Gaze
mechanics.desc: Twelve keys of the sky hang in the wall and six gates must be opened in the right order, each one a spirit who answers only the call of its own sign. It wakes when someone looks straight at it.
mechanics.flavor: Open, Gate of the Zodiac!

mechanics.name: The Statues That Move
mechanics.desc: A hall of statues that move whenever the delvers' eyes are elsewhere: they close in silently, and only holding their stony gaze keeps them still.
mechanics.flavor: Don't blink. Don't turn around.

mechanics.name: The Statues That Move: Statues of Stone
mechanics.desc: A hall of statues that move whenever the delvers' eyes are elsewhere: they close in silently, and only holding their stony gaze keeps them still. Statues of heavier stone: tougher and slower.
mechanics.flavor: Don't blink. Don't turn around.

mechanics.name: The Statues That Move: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A hall of statues that move whenever the delvers' eyes are elsewhere: they close in silently, and only holding their stony gaze keeps them still. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Don't blink. Don't turn around.

mechanics.name: The Statues That Move: Keystone
mechanics.desc: A hall of statues that move whenever the delvers' eyes are elsewhere: they close in silently, and only holding their stony gaze keeps them still. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Don't blink. Don't turn around.

mechanics.name: The Statues That Move: Statues of Weeping Marble
mechanics.desc: A hall of statues that move whenever the delvers' eyes are elsewhere: they close in silently, and only holding their stony gaze keeps them still. Statues that weep: the sight of them lowers the spirit as well as the speed.
mechanics.flavor: Don't blink. Don't turn around.

mechanics.name: The Statues That Move: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A hall of statues that move whenever the delvers' eyes are elsewhere: they close in silently, and only holding their stony gaze keeps them still. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Don't blink. Don't turn around.

mechanics.name: The Tarokka Spread
mechanics.desc: Three cards are laid on the table in a gypsy's pavilion and the room asks the delvers to lay them in the order the cards say; the cards, being what they are, show different orders to different eyes.
mechanics.flavor: The cards do not lie. They merely arrange.

mechanics.name: The Tarokka Spread: The Five-Card Spread
mechanics.desc: Three cards are laid on the table in a gypsy's pavilion and the room asks the delvers to lay them in the order the cards say; the cards, being what they are, show different orders to different eyes. A five-card spread, longer and meaner.
mechanics.flavor: The cards do not lie. They merely arrange.

mechanics.name: The Tarokka Spread: Threshold
mechanics.desc: Three cards are laid on the table in a gypsy's pavilion and the room asks the delvers to lay them in the order the cards say; the cards, being what they are, show different orders to different eyes. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: The cards do not lie. They merely arrange.

mechanics.name: The Tarokka Spread: Echo
mechanics.desc: Three cards are laid on the table in a gypsy's pavilion and the room asks the delvers to lay them in the order the cards say; the cards, being what they are, show different orders to different eyes. Repeat the pattern it shows.
mechanics.flavor: The cards do not lie. They merely arrange.

mechanics.name: The Tarokka Spread: The Cursed Reading
mechanics.desc: Three cards are laid on the table in a gypsy's pavilion and the room asks the delvers to lay them in the order the cards say; the cards, being what they are, show different orders to different eyes. A lectern of cards stands beside the table, and a wrong card brings the curse of the pavilion: wither and weakness.
mechanics.flavor: The cards do not lie. They merely arrange.

mechanics.name: The Tarokka Spread: Altar
mechanics.desc: Three cards are laid on the table in a gypsy's pavilion and the room asks the delvers to lay them in the order the cards say; the cards, being what they are, show different orders to different eyes. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
mechanics.flavor: The cards do not lie. They merely arrange.
